paragraphs: This week, Teacher Kim's class writes a weather diary. I am Mia, and this is my diary. On Monday, the sun is in the sky. It is hot, and I drink a lot of water. Everyone wants an ice drink. On Tuesday, it is windy. Leo's hat flies up into the sky. We run after it and laugh.

On Wednesday, the sky is gray. Then the rain comes. We sit in the classroom and watch it. The grass is green and wet. After the rain, May shouts, "Look!" There is a big rainbow in the sky. I count the colors. There are seven. On Thursday, I write, "Yesterday, there was a rainbow." Today the sky is blue and sunny again.

On Friday, Teacher Kim shows us a picture of snow. Snow is white and cold. It is like ice, but it is not the same. May asks, "Is snow hot or cold?" Leo says, "It is cold, of course!" I never see snow in my town. "What's this?" asks Leo. "It's snow!" says May. Teacher Kim says, "Some places have snow every year." I write that in my diary. Do you like snow? I want to see it one day.
